operators.description:

operators.description:
Add original-surface position, normal and material-index fields to the current node tree.

Context: A Shader or Geometry Nodes editor with an editable tree and configured source object.
Limit: Geometry sampling requires a separate UV-mapped source. It does not supply live AO, thickness or tangent normals.
Status: current
operators.label: Add Live Surface Data

operators.description:
Add a named trim strip or decal region fitted to the selected objects.

Context: A scene with an orthographic camera; select the objects that make the strip or piece.
Effects: Appends one region to the scene list. Trim strips span the full width; a decal fits its pieces plus the margin.
Limit: Bounds are evaluated bounding boxes seen by the scene camera, not exact silhouettes. Nothing selected gives the whole capture.
Status: experimental
operators.label: Add Region

properties.description: Trim strips repeat along U; decals are separate pieces
properties.label: Kind
properties.name: kind

properties.description: Texels added around the fitted bounds
properties.label: Margin
properties.name: margin_px

operators.description:
Add an overlapping feathered shader-patch layer above the canvas.

Context: An Aether authoring scene in Object Mode.
Limit: Feathers patch coverage; it does not repeat authored scatter geometry.
Status: current
operators.label: Add Feathered Texture Layer

operators.description:
Add an Aether smart group (surface data, wear, scratches, dents, grime or a finish) to the edited material.

Context: Shader Editor with an edited material tree.
Effects: Builds the group once per file (versioned) and adds one node at the cursor.
Status: current
operators.label: Add Smart Group

items.expression: [(k, k, f'Add {PREFIX}{k}') for k in BUILDERS]

operators.description:
Reserved UV-layer action.

Context: No supported use.
Limit: Returns CANCELLED and creates no geometry.
Status: placeholder
operators.label: Add UV Layer

operators.description:
Arrange the edited node tree as a left-to-right dependency tree.

Context: A Shader or Geometry Nodes editor with an edited tree (a material, a modifier group or an open group).
Effects: Moves every node of that tree; links and values are unchanged. Undo restores the previous layout.
Status: current
operators.label: Arrange as Tree

operators.description:
Bake the enabled mesh-derived source maps and publish a completed source-map manifest.

Context: Set the target mesh, UV map, folder and optional high-resolution source in Source Map Baking.
Limit: Runs synchronously. Projection requires one 0–1 UV tile; published files remain outside Blender Undo.
Status: current
operators.label: Bake Source Maps

operators.description:
Make the saved project folder self-contained: unpack images and reference them relatively.

Context: A saved blend; its folder is the project folder.
Limit: Writes packed or external images into //sources/ (identical files are reused) and rewrites image paths; existing files are never overwritten. Image sequences, movies and UDIM tiles are reported and left unchanged. Save the blend afterwards to keep the new references. File writes are not undone by Blender Undo.
Status: current
operators.label: Make Project Self-Contained

operators.description:
Replace the first Principled shader in the active material with an Aether master group.

Context: An active mesh with a node-based material containing a Principled BSDF.
Limit: Transfers supported sockets and links in that shared material; unsupported Principled features are not translated.
Status: current
operators.label: Convert to aether_master

operators.description:
Replace an Aether master group in the active material with a Principled shader.

Context: An active object with an Aether master material.
Limit: Transfers supported sockets and links; returns without conversion when no compatible group is found.
Status: current
operators.label: Convert to Principled BSDF

operators.description:
Create a one-unit-square source and open its Aether authoring scene.

Context: A window and scene with Aether registered.
Limit: Creates source and authoring data; arbitrary shader fields and edge geometry are not made periodic automatically.
Status: current
operators.label: Create Tile Material Scene

operators.description:
Capture the construction in horizontal slabs for near-field relief in an engine.

Context: A working project with an orthographic scene camera and an export folder.
Limit: Writes <export folder>/nearfield/: per slab 16-bit PNGs (Base Color with coverage alpha, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO, Height over the slab's range) and <name>_nearfield.json. Each slab is a clip-range capture, so only geometry within it is seen; relief that exists only in the shader appears in normals and Height, never in coverage. AO lacks occlusion from geometry outside the slab. Experimental: no engine consumes it yet.
Status: experimental
operators.label: Export Near-Field Slabs

operators.description:
Wrap selected mesh-layer materials with shared feather coverage controls.

Context: Selected mesh layers in Object Mode.
Limit: Preserves editable geometry and original material sources; closed meshes need bounds, patch UV or an authored mask for a meaningful outline.
Status: current
operators.label: Feather Selected Layer

operators.description:
Refit the active layer footprint to its evaluated geometry.

Context: An active mesh layer with feather controls.
Limit: Updates captured footprint data; it does not flatten geometry or alter tile spacing.
Status: current
operators.label: Fit Footprint to Geometry

operators.description:
Copy the last measured Z range into the remap of the selected layers.

Context: Selected objects that were part of a Height capture.
Limit: Measured values come from the last export or preview that rendered Height. Sets From to Manual with the measured range and leaves To unchanged unless Match is enabled.
Status: current
operators.label: Use Measured Range

properties.description: Also set To Min/Max to the measured range (identity remap)
properties.label: Match
properties.name: match_target

operators.description:
Set output participation and AO casting on selected mesh layers.

Context: Selected meshes in Object Mode.
Limit: Normal Only also disables AO casting. Individual checkboxes edit the active object, while the preset affects all selected meshes.
Status: current
operators.label: Set Layer Contributions

properties.description: ALL, NORMAL_ONLY or NO_AO participation for every selected mesh
properties.label: preset
properties.name: preset

operators.description:
Assign a renderer-owned texture preview for the active map on a supporting custom build.

Context: An Aether authoring scene using EEVEE and ShaderNodeTexCameraOutput.
Limit: Experimental single-map path. Selective AO falls back to rendered cache preview; simultaneous live PBR is not implemented.
Status: experimental
operators.label: Live Camera Preview

operators.description:
Integrate the active photo normal map into a height image and drive Bump with it.

Context: The active node of the active object's material is an Image Texture holding a tangent-space normal map that feeds the Aether master.
Limit: Writes <image>_height.png into //sources/; the blend must be saved. The normal image node is kept but unlinked from the master. The metre scale comes from the surface/UV area of the meshes using the material (otherwise the camera tile), divided by any Mapping repeat; adjust Distance or Strength by eye.
Status: current
operators.label: Normal Map to Bump Height

properties.description: Green-channel convention of the input normal map
properties.label: Convention
properties.name: convention

operators.description:
Open the target source-map folder in the operating system file browser.

Context: A selected source-bake target and a resolvable map folder.
Limit: Opens an external application; it does not open the final PBR export folder.
Status: current
operators.label: Open Export Directory

operators.description:
Render the full map set into the 3D PBR preview with layer contributions applied.

Context: An Aether authoring scene with output maps and a preview object.
Limit: Uses the file-backed preview cache and synchronous rendering; Edit Layers returns the authoring route.
Status: current
operators.label: Preview Layer Result

operators.description:
Remove the active region from the scene list.

Context: A scene with at least one region.
Status: experimental
operators.label: Remove Region

operators.description:
Repeat the selected layer result at tile offsets after its existing modifiers.

Context: Selected mesh or curve objects in Object Mode.
Limit: Copies the evaluated seeded result; oversized features need a sufficient Repeat Radius.
Status: current
operators.label: Repeat Geometry for Tile

operators.description:
Restore the authoring camera view and frame the evaluated preview object.

Context: An Aether scene with a window, authoring camera and .stx_preview object.
Effects: Switches this window to the Aether workspace and changes its view framing.
Limit: Does not isolate collections or enable live capture; local-view filtering remains unchanged.
operators.label: Restore Aether Views

operators.description:
Create an editable seeded collection scatter and repeat its result across the tile.

Context: An Aether authoring scene in Object Mode and a nonempty source collection.
Limit: Direct children use reset transforms and local geometry; does not hide originals, convert materials or resolve collisions. Canvas is XY from zero; assets should use Aether materials.
Status: current
operators.label: Scatter Collection as Tile Layer

properties.description: Source collection name, or use the scene picker when empty
properties.label: Collection
properties.name: collection_name

operators.description:
Add a Base Color entry and select it in the current scene map list.

Context: A scene with Aether registered.
Limit: Only changes the map list; no file is rendered.
Status: current
operators.label: Add Map

operators.description:
Route the full authoring material and select All Maps preview mode.

Context: A scene with the Aether master material groups.
Limit: Does not render or rebuild the cached 3D preview; the UI also labels this Edit Layers.
Status: current
operators.label: Show Full Material

operators.description:
Select a map, route its authoring output and configure its image settings.

Context: An Aether scene and a valid zero-based index.
Limit: Changes the shared output route and scene render settings; does not render. Derived outputs (packed, DirectX, inverted) show their first source capture; Height shows raw metres, so use Render Fast Preview for the normalized image.
Status: current
operators.label: Apply Settings for Selected Map

properties.description: Zero-based entry in the scene output map list
properties.label: index
properties.name: index

operators.description:
Create an Aether authoring scene with a UV canvas, preview object and orthographic camera.

Context: Set scene.export_settings.source_object to a mesh with a UV map.
Limit: Switches the window scene/workspace and creates datablocks. The selected source remains the live geometry input.
Status: current
operators.label: Create Bake Scene

operators.description:
Reserved single-map export action.

Context: No supported use.
Limit: Returns CANCELLED without writing a file; use Render All Maps.
Status: placeholder
operators.label: Export Single Map

properties.description: Zero-based entry in the scene output map list
properties.label: index
properties.name: index

operators.description:
Replace the scene map list with the chosen engine or workflow preset.

Context: A scene with Aether registered.
Limit: Replaces custom map entries; does not remove existing exported files. Packed and Height outputs are derived from separate captures at export, so they cost one render per distinct source map.
Status: current
operators.label: Load Map Preset

properties.description: Named output preset; replaces the current map list

items.expression: [(key, label, description) for (key, label, description, _) in PRESETS]

properties.label: Preset
properties.name: preset

operators.description:
Remove the current map-list entry and adjust the active index.

Context: An active scene map list.
Limit: Does not delete previously exported files.
Status: current
operators.label: Remove Map

operators.description:
Refresh the cached 3D preview using the selected preview mode and resolution.

Context: An Aether scene with a .stx_preview object and output maps.
Limit: Active Map shows one output; All Maps renders the full stack. Uses file-backed cache images and can block the interface.
Status: current
operators.label: Render Fast Preview

operators.description:
Render the complete output map list and assign the resulting PBR material to the preview.

Context: An Aether authoring scene with a camera, output folder and supported material routes.
Limit: Runs synchronously at full resolution, one EEVEE capture per direct map and per source of derived maps (Height, packed, DirectX, inverted). Writes <name>_maps.json with encodings and the height range in metres. File publication is not undone by Blender Undo. Restores scoped output and layer state on failure.
Status: current
operators.label: Render All Maps

operators.description:
Replace selected image samples with matching-coordinate triplanar groups.

Context: Selected Image Texture nodes in a Shader Editor.
Limit: Preserves color and alpha links. Tangent normal maps still require correct per-projection normal frames.
Status: current
operators.label: Use Triplanar Projection

operators.description:
Replace selected legacy triplanar groups with the current projection weights.

Context: Selected triplanar groups in a Shader Editor.
Limit: Retains supported image settings and links; does not establish tangent-normal reorientation.
Status: current
operators.label: Repair Selected Triplanar Groups

operators.description:
Add or refresh a baked source-map group in the current node tree.

Context: A Shader or Geometry Nodes editor and a folder containing recognized source maps.
Limit: Uses the completed-set manifest when present. Position reconstruction needs bounds metadata.
Status: current
operators.label: Add Source Maps

properties.name: directory

operators.description:
Repair recognized data-image interpretation inside selected nodes and nested groups.

Context: Selected nodes in a Shader or Geometry Nodes editor.
Limit: Preserves shared color-image uses; missing files still require relinking.
Status: current
operators.label: Repair Selected Source Maps
